I would like help designing, coding and refining a multitouch microtonal music program designed for touchscreen surfaces. I would like it to utilize libraries, runtimes and programming language(s) which will result in realtime operation with the least possible lag between inputs and sounds, while at the same time remaining stable. Allow the program to utilize lower or higher levels of RAM by allowing buffer sizes to be increased or decreased. The program should ideally have the ability to be multiplatform, focusing on Windows 11, IOS and Android. If only one or two of these platforms will work easily, focus on that. The interface should be simple but powerful, including the following features: Being able to be displayed in many common resolutions, including 1024 by 768 and 1920 by 1080. Feature a a variable limit tonality diamond, (selectable as 3-limit, 5-limit, 7-limit or 13-limit) occupying the main portion of the screen, with circular buttons denoting the various pitches. Allow for “diamond” shaped buttons which create the appearance of a tonality diamond “grid”. The size and x:y spacing of the buttons should be individually variable, allowing for the overall shape of the tonality diamond to be of different aspect rations, with 1:1 (square, even sided diamond) being the default. Allow for the tonality diamond to be changed in rotation angle on the screen. Button sizes and spacings should allow for the tonality diamond to appear to be between half and twice the size of the screen. with the size being variable between two extremes: half the size of the screen to twice the size. Color each pitch according to which limit it belongs (Red for unity, yellow for 3 limit, blue for 5 limit, green for 7 limit and purple for 13 limit) Allow these colors to be changed from the default to any other screen color. Allow the user as a selectable option to pitch bend these circles, with visual feedback, by dragging them with the fingertip. Motion of the circles should be constrained along one of two possible directions of pitch travel, which one being determined by what direction the finger initially goes. Allow bent pitch circles to snap onto other pitches in the tonality diamond (i.e be slightly attracted to, and held by fixed pitches on the diamond) with this setting being able to be toggled on or off. Allow for multitimbral synthesis (polyphony), with the number of allowed voices being able to be selected, from 1 to 10. Allow for the generated sound to be of various waveform types, including sine, saw, square, and in general include a simple “synth” tab with 10 possible configurations (save slots) which allows for modification of these and other typical parameters like modulation or reverb. Include a “Pitch Off” button on the bottom right of the main tonality diamond screen which can be tapped/clicked in order to stop all pitches from sounding. Allow this button to be relocated by dragging it around, and allow it to be ordinarily locked in place. Add a volume slider on the bottom which can also be relocated. All other settings should be found in a “Settings” menu. Allow for settings to be saved into, and loaded from, a common format such as xml. Settings should be as follows, reiterating for you the changes the program can accommodate: 1. Tonality Limit: (options: 3,5,7,13) 2. Button Size: (small, medium, large) 3. Button spacing: (small, medium, large) 4 Button shape: (circular or diamond) 5. Limit Color: (color boxes next to each limit, unity, 3,5,7 and 13, which, when clicked on, open a “color picker” 6. Pitch Bend (on or off) 7. Pitch snap (on or off) 8. Polyphony: (1-10) 9. Pitch Off Lock (on or off) 10. Volume Lock (on or off)

This application is built using **React 18** and **TypeScript** with **Tailwind CSS** for styling. It features a custom **Web Audio API** engine for low-latency, polyphonic sound generation without external heavy dependencies.

2.  **Audio Engine**: A custom `AudioService` handling polyphony (up to 10 voices), customizable waveforms, envelope shaping, and gain control.
3.  **Interaction**: Full multitouch support using Pointer Events. Supports individual note pitch bending by dragging.
4.  **Customization**: Fully adjustable button sizes, spacing, rotation, colors, and global diamond aspect ratio.
